goal: Make processing state and data provenance obvious; keep chrome quiet.

primaryWorkspace.desktop: source / result split with shared toolbar
primaryWorkspace.mobile: source then result; never side-by-side below 768px
primaryWorkspace.sourceSemantics: original identifiers use subtle sensitive highlight
primaryWorkspace.resultSemantics: pseudonyms use mono + cipher; surrounding content remains normal text

states.processing: Use status label and subtle progress; do not imply completion
states.review: Use sensitive amber, never danger red
states.error: Use danger only for actual failure

rules: Do not hide original/result distinction behind tabs on wide screens unless product complexity requires it
Do not use cards for every setting
Table density should be professional, not oversized marketing UI
